Counter Drone RF Analyzer / Drone DF Simulator

A desktop application for uploading RF recordings, visualizing power spectra and spectrograms, and presenting AI-based drone-presence predictions with signal measurements.

RF signal analysisPower-spectrum visualizationSpectrogramsMachine learning
Source code ↗
01 / THE DETAILS

The problem & intended users

RF recordings need to be interpreted through spectrum views, signal measurements, and classification. This project brings those views together in a desktop analysis workflow.

People exploring RF recordings, signal measurements, and drone-presence analysis.

02 / THE DETAILS

The approach

Upload an RF recording, inspect its power spectrum and spectrogram, then review the drone-presence prediction and confidence alongside RSSI, peak power, and noise-floor measurements.

03 / THE DETAILS

My contribution

Developed the desktop RF analysis project, bringing recording upload, signal visualization, AI-based drone-presence prediction, and signal readouts into one application.
